test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

AZ - CX - GT

XC - ZA - DW
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed here in the given triads is:

AZ - CX - GT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca928f3e00dc7e940707e0301ada225f607b55f96b725a20c57edce9ae05ef3a.png] 

And, XC - ZA - DW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ff32ce9666afecd1efda7eaf231d114a1ac1392d54f41791edecabf04af6cf0.png] 

Similarly,

Let us consider the given options:

Option 1) DW - FU - JQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b4b3a45e436e7860a256194a032f6da75f15738250f5809389ead44c2cbf9b4.png] 

Option 2) MN - OM - SH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df50d4f307face0707c5268c1c02d3ef8fedecd2b2d968bde692bcea07efba46.png] 

Option 3) TH - VE - ZA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a28e0f7baa16665d67ea774b25d9286aa149e79fa06351722192af61af6d9859.png] 

Option 4) PK - RI - WD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fa0f53c5e4e300844dc6165042ef28018f9802297702d656290c7da2adb872e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is “DW - FU - JQ”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• ** ****PK - RI - WD** → In option 4 opposite letter pair is given but the alternate difference is not the match so we don't consider option 4 as correct. Thus, only option 1) is correct.
